items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Gershwin heard Lew Leslie make that remark... So Lew Leslie, the head of the show

ctx.x: That's right. That's a weird name. He told Joe to sit down, and George Gershwin would explain to him just what was what and how it was really supposed to go. So Gershwin heard Lew Leslie make that remark, and he said to Lew Leslie and everybody else standing around there...he said, "Well, there's nothing I can tell this man about playing 'Rhapsody.' He played it perfectly. There's nothing to tell him." Well, I mean, that was the big feather in the cap of Joe Steele, I mean, to have somebody like Gershwin make a…
Now, was this just the piano, or was it with an orchestra?
